skills.trigger: When evaluating extra-luminal air (pneumomediastinum, subcutaneous emphysema) on CT to determine the mechanism of associated pneumorrhachis (air in the spinal canal).
steps: Confirm the presence of extensive pneumomediastinum and subcutaneous emphysema, particularly tracking into the neck and retropharyngeal/paraspinal spaces.
Inspect the spinal canal at multiple levels for hypodense air collections within the epidural space.
Trace the continuity of air from the mediastinum/neck soft tissues through the neural exit foramina into the spinal canal to establish the pathway.
Distinguish this indirect tracking mechanism from direct traumatic entry or isolated findings by verifying the anatomical connection via the foramina.
